description_excerpt: Job Description Products: Electrical Connectors for the Automotive Industry. • Perform design calculations, including tolerance analysis and dimensional measurement (3D data). • Apply engineering methodologies such as FMEA, DRBFM, DFMA, etc. to ensure robust product design. • Support testing activities, including sample preparation, test setup, and execution. • Assist in technical risk assessments, problem solving, customer approvals, and tooling release processes. • Assist in developing and optimizing design solutions. • Explore and apply AI and digital tools to improve design efficiency…
